mapper.select: select a.jdxz_dm jdxzDm,b.jdxzmc from hx_dj.dj_nsrxx a,hx_dm_zdy.dm_gy_jdxz b where (a.nsrsbh=#{nsrsbh} or a.shxydm=#{shxydm}) and a.jdxz_dm=b.jdxz_dm and rownum=1

select * from ( select a.swryxm as swryMc,b.rysfmc,b.zsfbz,b.sfswjg_dm as sfswjgDm from hx_dm_zdy.dm_gy_swry a, hx_qx.dm_qx_swrysf b where a.swry_dm = b.swry_dm and b.yxbz='Y' and sysdate between b.sfyxqq and b.sfyxqz and a.swry_dm = #{czryDm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by zsfbz desc ) where rownum=1

select d.djxh,nvl(d.shxydm,d.nsrsbh) as nsrsbh,lcswsx_dm as lcswsxDm,y.ssq as sssq,y.sbpc from hx_dj.dj_nsrxx d, hx_ckts.ckts_ty_ywblxx y where d.djxh=y.djxh and y.lcslid = #{lcslid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and nvl(y.zfbz_1,'N')<>'Y' and rownum=1

SELECT count(1) AS gwzbLcbs, nvl (sum(CASE WHEN trunc (r.rwywcsj) - trunc (sysdate) <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ),0) AS gwzbJjcq FROM zj_mh.mh_rwxx r, hx_ckts.ckts_ty_ywblxx t, hx_qx.dm_qx_swrysf s WHERE r.lcslid = t.lcslid AND r.xndbrdm = s.swrysf_dm AND r.yxbz = 'Y' AND s.swry_dm = #{czryDm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select sfswjg_dm from hx_qx.dm_qx_swrysf sf where sf.swry_dm=#{swrydm} and sf.swrysf_dm=#{sfdm} and sysdate between sf.sfyxqq and sf.sfyxqz and sf.yxbz='Y'
select count(1) from zj_mh.mh_rwxx rw where rw.xndbrdm = #{xndbrdm} and rw.rwstatus = '01' and rw.rwzt not like '%发放-%'
select count(1) from zj_mh.mh_rwxx rw where rw.gwxh = #{gwxh} and rw.rwzt not like '%发放-%' and rw.xndbrdm = #{sfdm} --放税务人员身份代码 and rw.rwstatus = '01' --未签收表示待办
select count(1) from zj_mh.mh_rwxx rw where rw.gwxh = #{gwxh} and rw.rwzt not like '%发放-%' and rw.xndbrdm = #{sfdm} --放税务人员身份代码 and rw.rwstatus = '02' --已签收表示在办

select rw.rwfqsj, lc.lcswsx_dm as lcswsxDm, lc.ssq || decode(lc.sbpc,'','','-'||lc.sbpc) as sssq, dj.nsrmc, nvl(dj.shxydm, dj.nsrsbh) as nsrsbh, rw.rwzt as rwmc, lc.ckqygllb_dm as flglcd, rw.gwmc, lc.lcslid, rw.rwfqrmc, rw.gzxid from zj_mh.mh_rwxx rw, hx_ckts.ckts_ty_ywblxx lc, hx_dj.dj_nsrxx dj where rw.lcslid = lc.lcslid and dj.djxh = lc.djxh and rw.gwxh = #{gwxh} and rw.rwzt not like '%发放-%' and rw.xndbrdm = #{sfdm} --放税务人员身份代码 and rw.rwstatus = '01' --未签收表示待办

select rw.rwfqsj, lc.lcswsx_dm as lcswsxDm, lc.ssq || decode(lc.sbpc,'','','-'||lc.sbpc) as sssq, dj.nsrmc, nvl(dj.shxydm, dj.nsrsbh) as nsrsbh, rw.rwzt as rwmc, lc.ckqygllb_dm as flglcd, rw.gwmc, lc.lcslid, rw.rwfqrmc, rw.gzxid from zj_mh.mh_rwxx rw, hx_ckts.ckts_ty_ywblxx lc, hx_dj.dj_nsrxx dj where rw.lcslid = lc.lcslid and dj.djxh = lc.djxh and rw.gwxh = #{gwxh} and rw.rwzt not like '%发放-%' and rw.xndbrdm = #{sfdm} --放税务人员身份代码 and rw.rwstatus = '02' --已签收表示在办

select sf.swrysf_dm as swrysfDm, sf.rysfmc,sf.swry_dm,sf.sfswjg_dm,sf.sfyxqq,sf.sfyxqz,sf.yxbz from hx_qx.qx_jggw_swrysf gs, hx_qx.dm_qx_swrysf sf where gs.gwxh=#{gwxh} and gs.swrysf_dm = sf.swrysf_dm and sysdate between sf.sfyxqq and sf.sfyxqz and sf.yxbz='Y'
select sfdm as swrysfDm,swrymc as rysfmc,status from SHZS_WP_SWRY where gwxh = #{gwxh}

select rw.rwfqsj, lc.lcswsx_dm as lcswsxDm, lc.ssq || decode(lc.sbpc,'','','-'||lc.sbpc) as sssq, dj.nsrmc, nvl(dj.shxydm, dj.nsrsbh) as nsrsbh, rw.rwzt as rwmc, lc.ckqygllb_dm as flglcd, rw.gwmc, lc.lcslid, rw.rwfqrmc, rw.gzxid from zj_mh.mh_rwxx rw, hx_ckts.ckts_ty_ywblxx lc, hx_dj.dj_nsrxx dj where rw.lcslid = lc.lcslid and dj.djxh = lc.djxh and rw.gzxid=#{id}
select sfdm from SHZS_WP_SWRY where gwdm= #{gwdm} and swrydm=#{swrydm}
select sfdm as swrysfDm,swrymc as rysfmc,status from SHZS_WP_SWRY where gwxh = #{gwxh} and swjgDm=#{swjgDm}

select dm.lcswsx_dm as lcswsxdm, dm.lcswsxmc as sbywmc, count(1) as cnt from zj_mh.mh_rwxx rw, hx_ckts.ckts_ty_ywblxx lc, hx_dm_qg.dm_gy_lcswsx dm where rw.lcslid = lc.lcslid and dm.lcswsx_dm = lc.lcswsx_dm and rw.xndbrdm = #{xndbrdm} and rw.rwstatus = '01' and rw.rwzt not like '%发放-%' group by dm.lcswsx_dm, dm.lcswsxmc order by dm.lcswsx_dm

select yw.lcswsx_dm as sbywbDm,yw.djxh, sx.lcswsxmc as sbywbMc, nvl(dj.shxydm, dj.nsrsbh) as nsrsbh, ba.hgqy_dm as qyhgdm, dj.nsrmc, yw.tsswjg_dm_1 as swjgDm, yw.ckqygllb_dm as flglcd, ba.ckhwtmsjsff_dm as tsjsfsDm, jd.jdxzmc, decode(yw.wzhbz, 'Y', '是', 'N', '否') as wzhqy, yw.ssq as sssq, yw.sbpc, trunc(yw.qdsj) as sbrq from hx_ckts.ckts_ty_ywblxx yw left join hx_dj.dj_nsrxx dj on dj.djxh = yw.djxh left join hx_ckts.ckts_ba_baxx_jgb ba on ba.djxh = yw.djxh left join hx_dm_qg.dm_gy_lcswsx sx on sx.lcswsx_dm = yw.lcswsx_dm left join hx_dm_zdy.dm_gy_jdxz jd on jd.jdxz_dm = dj.jdxz_dm where yw.lcslid = #{lcslid}

select rownum as id, shdxmc as errObj, ydjb_dm as errLev, ydbh as ydcode, ktgydbz as passFlag, sbxh as glywz1, '' as glywz2, ydnr as errMsg, shdx_dm as glywb1 from hx_ckts.CKTS_BL_MDT_SHYD_GCB where lcslid = #{lcslid}

select rownum as id, shdxmc as errObj, ydjb_dm as errLev, ydbh as ydcode, ktgydbz as passFlag, sbxh as glywz1, glh as glywz2, ydnr as errMsg, shdx_dm as glywb1 from hx_ckts.CKTS_BL_MTS_SHYD_GCB where lcslid = #{lcslid}

select rownum as id, shdxmc as errObj, ydjb_dm as errLev, ydbh as ydcode, ktgydbz as passFlag, sbxh as glywz1, '' as glywz2, ydnr as errMsg, shdx_dm as glywb1 from hx_ckts.CKTS_BL_DB_SHYD_GCB where lcslid = #{lcslid}

select rownum as id, shdxmc as errObj, ydjb_dm as errLev, ydbh as ydcode, ktgydbz as passFlag, sbxh as glywz1, '' as glywz2, ydnr as errMsg, '' as glywb1 from hx_ckts.CKTS_BL_ZB_SHYD_GCB where lcslid = #{lcslid}

select count(1) as sbcs from hx_ckts.ckts_ty_ywblxx t where (djxh, to_char(qdsj, 'yyyymm'), lcswsx_dm) = (select djxh, to_char(qdsj, 'yyyymm'), lcswsx_dm from hx_ckts.ckts_ty_ywblxx t1 where t1.lcslid = #{lcslid}) and nvl(t.zfbz_1,'N') = 'N' and t.lcslid = t.zlclcslid
select lcsx_dm as lcswsxdm, sbyw_mc as sbywmc from tl_bjts.dm_gt3_xml_config order by lcsx_dm

WITH SCSBQK AS ( SELECT B.DJXH, B.LCSWSX_DM, B.LCSLID, B.QDSJ, NVL(B.SDHCWCBZ,'0') AS SDHCWCBZ, B.QYZTLX, TRUNC(B.QYZTBGSJ) AS QYZTBGSJ FROM (SELECT T.DJXH, T.LCSWSX_DM, T.LCSLID, T.QDSJ, A.SDHCWCBZ, A.QYZTLX, A.QYZTBGSJ, A.LRRQ FROM HX_CKTS.CKTS_TY_YWBLXX T INNER JOIN HX_CKTS.CKTS_TY_SCSBQK A ON A.DJXH=T.DJXH WHERE T.LCSLID=#{lcslid} ORDER BY A.LRRQ DESC) B WHERE ROWNUM=1), SDHCBG AS ( SELECT D.DJXH, D.HCYYSM, D.HCJGSM FROM (SELECT C.DJXH, C.HCYYSM, C.HCJGSM, C.LRRQ FROM SCSBQK INNER JOIN HX_CKTS.CKTS_SDHC_SDHCBG_JGB C ON C.DJXH=SCSBQK.DJXH WHERE SCSBQK.SDHCWCBZ<>'2' AND REGEXP_LIKE(C.HCYYSM, DECODE(SCSBQK.QYZTLX, '1',DECODE(SCSBQK.LCSWSX_DM, 'LCSXA081042002','01|15', --首次申报退税|研发机构采购国产设备退税 'LCSXA081040001','01|19', --首次申报退税|综服企业首次申报代办退税 '01|20|21|22'), '2',DECODE(SCSBQK.LCSWSX_DM, 'LCSXA081038001','17', -- 免退税转免抵退 '18'), -- 免抵退转免退税 '3','12') -- 转登记纳税人再次转一般纳税人后首次申报 ) AND C.LRRQ >=SCSBQK.QYZTBGSJ ORDER BY C.LRRQ DESC) D WHERE ROWNUM=1) SELECT COUNT(1) as cnt FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCSBQK WHERE SCSBQK.SDHCWCBZ='2' UNION SELECT 1 FROM SDHCBG WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(SDHCBG.HCJGSM,'01|02|03|04')) AND EXISTS (SELECT * FROM SCSBQK INNER JOIN HX_CKTS.CKTS_TY_YWBLXX E ON E.DJXH=SCSBQK.DJXH AND E.LCSWSX_DM=SCSBQK.LCSWSX_DM WHERE E.LCSLID<>SCSBQK.LCSLID AND E.QDSJ>SCSBQK.QYZTBGSJ AND E.QDSJ<SCSBQK.QDSJ AND NVL(E.ZFBZ_1,'N')='N')

SELECT t.djxh, t.lcswsx_dm as lcswsxDm, t.ssq, t.sbpc, TO_CHAR(t.qdsj, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as sbrq, t.ckqygllb_dm as ckqygllbDm, t.lcslid FROM hx_ckts.ckts_ty_ywblxx t inner join zj_mh.mh_lcxx lc on lc.lcslid=t.lcslid WHERE t.lcswsx_dm in ('LCSXA081039001', 'LCSXA081038001') AND t.zlclcslid = t.lcslid AND nvl(t.zfbz_1, 'N') = 'N' AND nvl(t.FFBZ, 'N') = 'N' AND t.lcslid = #{lcslid} AND ROWNUM = 1
mapper.update: update SHZS_WP_SWRY set status=#{status} where gwxh=#{gwxh} and sfdm=#{sfdm}
